Title: Azure Digital Twins Explorer available in public preview

Body.Content:
The Azure Digital Twins Explorer is now available in preview as a web application, accessible from Azure Digital Twins instances in the Azure Portal or at explorer.digitaltwins.azure.net. This visual developer tool makes it easier to explore the Azure Digital Twins APIs, allowing you to validate your queries, modify your twin graph, reference your model graph, and much more. The Explorer codebase will continue to be available in the GitHub repository for more customized deployments.

Watch the Explorer IoT Show episode.

Check out the Explorer preview release blog post.

Read the documentation.
